cohort.attempt_policy: all ten actual successful attempts are attempt1; failures and retries outside cohort are not costed
cohort.rollout: before bu-q1hzqn pipeline changes; no before/after attribution
cohort.selection: first ten successful merge_group runs in preserved 30-run snapshot, each verified exact first-parent main commit

definitions.eligible_to_started_s: job.started_at minus latest completed_at of actual declared needs (all matrix siblings), or run.created_at for root jobs; derived from each exact historical workflow; scheduler/admission remainder, not account quota proof; negative clock-precision values retained
definitions.job_created_to_started_s: started_at-created_at; includes prerequisite delay and scheduler overhead, not a runner-quota proof
definitions.quantiles: ordinary median and nearest-rank p95 (ceil(.95*n)-1); n=10 makes p95 the maximum
definitions.queue_limit: enqueue/requeue-to-workflow wait unavailable; success-only cohort cannot establish total throughput or failed/retry cost
definitions.required_context_elapsed_s: run.created_at to latest actual completed_at among check, guards, frontend
definitions.selected_count: complete actual installed inventory node population, cross-bound to each run/head/attempt
definitions.static_count: AST source definitions; distinct from pytest collected/selected nodes
definitions.testcase_cost: sum of sanitized JUnit testcase durations including pytest setup/call/teardown; cumulative work, not parallel job wall
definitions.workflow_last_job_elapsed_s: run.created_at to latest completed_at among non-skipped jobs; API updated_at retained separately
